# vendor

- `globe.gl-2.34.4.min.js` — the official self-contained UMD build of [globe.gl](https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl) 2.34.4 (sets `window.Globe`).
- Source: https://unpkg.com/globe.gl@2.34.4/dist/globe.gl.min.js (byte-identical on jsDelivr).
- Licence: MIT — https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl/blob/master/LICENSE
- Upgrade: download the new version under its own versioned filename (`globe.gl-X.Y.Z.min.js`), update the one `<script defer>` reference in `index.html`, delete the old file.
